svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.7.2 Starter Strip
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING
Starter Strip

g.text: Starter strip about 12 mm beyond the eaves and rake, nailed
along the bottom edge at 300 mm o.c. or less, (1)
Starter strip at the eave and rake
Type M mineral-surfaced roll roofing, not
Shingles of the same weight and quality,
tabs facing up the roof slope, (2)(b)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
A starter strip is installed along the lower
edge of the roof so that it extends
approximately 12 mm (½″) beyond the eaves and
rake of the roof and fastened along the bottom
edge with nails spaced not more than 300 mm
Starter strips are
(a) at least Type M mineral-surfaced roll roofing
not less than 300 mm (11 13/16″) wide, (b)
shingles of the same weight and quality as those
used as a roof covering with tabs facing up the
roof slope, or (c) pre-manufactured starter
strips installed with sealant at the eaves.
Starter strips need not be provided where eave
protection of not less than Type M
mineral-surfaced roll roofing is provided.
Drawn: eave protection not shown. In A the first courses are laid over part of the starter. Sentence (3) is not drawn. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.26.7.2. (page 9-246)
